# System prompt

Technical reference for **Settings / System prompt**. The app shows a short summary;
this page keeps the full detail.

## System prompt (page help)

These are Moguri's actual model instructions, not a desktop-only copy. Edits apply to new turns;
running turns keep their recorded instruction snapshot.

## Consent

The consent checkbox was previously "I understand this can break functionality. Hard permissions cannot
be overridden."

## Preview

The preview shows the effective committed instructions, including protected execution guidance and
approved project knowledge.
